title: OrbitAI — Calm, Intelligent AI for Focus and Deep Work
summary: OrbitAI is a personal AI productivity hub designed to help users focus, plan intelligently, and work in alignment with their energy — not against it.

meta.scope: Product strategy, UX/UI, interaction design, system design

sections.overview:
OrbitAI is a personal AI productivity hub designed to help users focus, plan intelligently, and work in alignment with their energy — not against it.

Unlike traditional productivity tools that optimize tasks in isolation, OrbitAI is built around human energy, attention, and decision fatigue. It combines intelligent scheduling, explainable AI, and distraction-free focus into a single, cohesive system.

This case study explores how product thinking, calm visual design, and purposeful motion were used to design both the landing experience and the core dashboard of OrbitAI.

‍
sections.caseStudy:
1. The Problem

Modern productivity tools help people manage tasks — but not manage energy, focus, or mental clarity.

People don’t struggle because they lack to-do lists.They struggle because:

  • Tasks are scheduled at the wrong time
  • Focus is constantly interrupted
  • Tools overwhelm instead of guide
  • Productivity systems ignore human energy rhythms

Most apps ask users to adapt to the tool.OrbitAI was designed to do the opposite.

‍

2. The Insight

Through observation and personal experience, I identified a key insight:

Productivity is not about doing more —it’s about doing the right work, at the right time, with the right energy.

This led to three core design principles:

  • Energy-aware scheduling
  • AI that explains why, not just what
  • Calm interfaces that reduce cognitive load

OrbitAI is not a task manager. It’s a personal AI companion for focus and decision-making.

‍

3. The Product Vision

OrbitAI is a personal AI hub that:

  • Understands tasks written in natural language
  • Optimizes schedules based on energy patterns
  • Protects focus during deep work
  • Learns from behavior and improves over time

Instead of dashboards full of noise, OrbitAI offers:

  • Clear guidance
  • Gentle nudges
  • Confident decisions

‍

4. Core Experience Overview

OrbitAI is built around four connected systems, not isolated features.

1️⃣ i. Dashboard — The Command Center

The dashboard gives an immediate sense of control and calm.

Key goals:

  • Show what matters today
  • Reduce decision fatigue
  • Surface urgency without stress

Design decisions:

  • Minimal color usage for hierarchy
  • Clear prioritization
  • Friendly AI presence to humanize the experience

This is where users feel oriented, not overwhelmed.

‍

2️⃣ ii. Smart Schedule — Energy-Based Planning

Instead of fixed calendars, OrbitAI schedules tasks around human energy flow.

Key features:

  • Morning / afternoon / evening energy awareness
  • AI-optimized task placement
  • Clear explanation: “Why this task is here”

Why it matters:
Users don’t need blind automation — they need trust.
By explaining decisions, OrbitAI builds confidence in the system.

‍

3️⃣ iii. Task Intelligence — From Thought to Action

Users describe tasks naturally:

“Prepare investor pitch for next week”

OrbitAI analyzes:

  • Intent
  • Energy requirement
  • Strategic importance
  • Time estimation
  • Dependencies

Then it transforms thoughts into structured, actionable work.

Design focus:

  • Clear before/after states
  • AI insight cards instead of raw data
  • One-click actions (add to schedule, simulate change)

This turns mental clutter into clarity.

‍

4️⃣ iv. Focus Mode — Protecting Deep Work

Focus Mode is intentionally minimal and distraction-free.

Key ideas:

  • One task
  • One timer
  • One purpose

‍

During focus:

  • Notifications muted
  • Task switching blocked
  • Sessions guided by AI recommendations

‍

After focus:

  • Gentle reinforcement
  • Progress acknowledgment
  • Adaptive learning for future schedules

This reinforces positive behavior, not pressure.

‍

5️⃣ v. Insights — Learning From You

OrbitAI doesn’t just track productivity — it understands patterns.

Insights include:

  • Productivity rhythm by time of day
  • Focus streaks
  • Energy dips
  • What improves or harms performance

Insights are:

  • Short
  • Actionable
  • Automatically updated

The goal is not analytics — it’s self-awareness.

‍

5. Design System & Visual Language

OrbitAI uses a calm futuristic aesthetic:

  • Dark UI to reduce eye strain
  • Soft glow accents for guidance
  • Motion used only when meaningful

Principles:

  • Motion explains, not decorates
  • Color signals priority, not noise
  • AI presence feels supportive, not intrusive

The interface is designed to disappear when the user is focused.

6. Challenges & Decisions

Challenge: Avoid making AI feel magical but vague
Solution: Explain AI decisions clearly in-context

Challenge: Avoid feature overload
Solution: Design around systems, not features

Challenge: Balance futuristic visuals with usability
Solution: Subtle motion + strong hierarchy

7. Outcome & What This Demonstrates

OrbitAI demonstrates my ability to:

  • Think in product systems
  • Design AI-assisted experiences responsibly
  • Balance aesthetics with clarity
  • Design for human behavior, not trends

This project represents:

  • Product thinking
  • UX maturity
  • Visual restraint
  • Technical readiness for implementation

Final Thought

OrbitAI is not about productivity hacks.
It’s about designing a calmer relationship between humans and work.

‍

title: Elegantnast
summary: A minimalist, luxury website for Elegantnast — a certified lash stylist and beauty trainer offering premium eyelash extension services and workshops in Germany.

sections.overview: The goal was to elevate Lisa Prezer’s brand with a high-end website that reflects beauty, elegance, and trust. It needed multiple sections including services, portfolio, booking, customer reviews, and password-protected training content — all consistent with her refined brand identity.
sections.solution: I crafted a modern, airy design using neutral tones, serif typography, and subtle silver accents to achieve a “luxury spa” aesthetic. The structure included a CMS-based portfolio, pricing lists, and dedicated training pages, all localized in German using Figma + Webflow tools for seamless translation and scalability.
sections.result: A visually cohesive and responsive Webflow website that communicates elegance and credibility while remaining easy for the client to manage. Lisa and David both praised the project for its premium aesthetic, brand alignment, and professional execution.

title: Timms Team – High-Converting Landing Page for a German Renovation Company
summary: A conversion-optimized landing page designed and developed for Timms Team, a German renovation and interior construction company. The goal was to increase inquiry rates through trust-driven design, strong messaging, and a premium user experience optimized for mobile.

sections.overview:
Timms Team wanted a dedicated conversion page to attract more qualified renovation leads in Germany. While the main website existed, they needed a high-impact, focused landing page that communicated trust, showcased expertise, and drove visitors toward booking a consultation.

My role was to transform a basic page idea into a complete conversion-centered experience—using UX strategy, clear messaging, and Webflow implementation to support their lead-generation goals.

‍
sections.solution:
I designed a fully optimized landing page built around psychological conversion triggers and industry trust signals. Key elements included:

  • Premium hero section with clear value proposition
  • Trust badges & credibility markers placed above the fold
  • Service breakdown with clear benefits
  • Transformation showcase with before/after visuals
  • Social proof section including reviews & client logos
  • Strong call-to-actions placed strategically across the page
  • Mobile-first responsive layout optimized for 80% mobile users
  • High-speed, SEO-friendly Webflow build
  • A conversion-oriented form with lead-qualifying fields

The design approach focused strongly on clarity, trust, and real-world proof — the elements that matter most in home-improvement and renovation industries.

‍
sections.result:
The new landing page significantly improved Timms Team’s online presence and lead-generation quality. The client described the result as “Amazing work again,” reinforcing strong ongoing collaboration.

The landing page now:

  • Communicates value clearly and professionally
  • Establishes high credibility within seconds
  • Guides users smoothly toward taking action
  • Supports the company’s sales funnel more effectively
  • Strengthened the business–designer relationship, leading to more projects

‍

title: Macrostate - UniFi Door Access Solution Page
summary: I designed and developed a responsive, conversion-focused Webflow solution page for Macro State, showcasing their UniFi Door Access offerings. The project involved transforming a detailed content brief into a visually engaging, user-friendly experience with interactive components and CMS integration.

sections.overview: Macro State needed a dedicated solution page to serve as a key step in their sales funnel—where visitors could explore their UniFi Door Access systems in depth after landing on the homepage. The goal was to combine clarity, visual appeal, and conversion optimization within a single, well-structured Webflow page.
sections.solution:
I started by creating a Figma mockup to align the design direction with the client’s brand. Once approved, I built the page in Webflow, incorporating:

  • A CMS-based modal system in the UniFi Hardware section for scalable content updates.
  • Subtle, smooth animations and hover effects to enhance user experience.
  • Interactive content switching for the Access Types section, triggered by hover or click.
  • JavaScript enhancements for accessibility, including Escape-key modal close and background click detection.
  • Full responsive optimization across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
sections.result: The final page delivered a clean, modern design that effectively communicates Macro State’s offerings while driving conversions. It’s fully interactive, accessible, and easy to manage—creating a professional digital experience that elevates the brand and supports their sales goals.

title: FlexiBank - Online Banking Mobile App
summary: A modern mobile banking experience designed to make financial management accessible, secure, and effortless for small business owners in Nigeria.

sections.overview: FlexiBank is a mobile banking app built to help users manage their finances digitally without needing to visit a physical branch. The goal was to create an intuitive and accessible platform for users—especially small business owners—who face mobility or location challenges. The app enables users to open and manage accounts, transfer money, track expenses, and secure transactions from anywhere, anytime.
sections.problemStatement: Adamu Ibrahim, a 42-year-old small business owner in Kaduna, Nigeria, struggles with accessing physical bank branches due to mobility and distance limitations. Traditional banking systems are slow, inaccessible, and often require in-person verification. He needs a reliable, easy-to-use mobile banking solution that allows him to manage his finances remote
sections.goalStatement:
To design a secure, intuitive, and accessible digital banking experience that simplifies everyday financial tasks. The solution aims to let users open accounts, send and receive money, manage cards, and track expenses—all within a simple, trustworthy interface.

‍
sections.researchInsights:
I analyzed several leading mobile banking apps such as Kuda, Opay, and GTBank to identify common pain points like complex onboarding and poor accessibility.
Through user research, I discovered that:

  • Users prefer biometric login for faster access.
  • Long sign-up forms discourage new users.
  • Small business owners want clear expense tracking and secure transfers.

These insights guided my design decisions throughout the process.

‍
sections.designProcess:
1️⃣ Empathize – Conducted user research and identified accessibility challenges.
2️⃣ Define – Mapped user flows and pain points to clarify priorities.
3️⃣ Ideate – Sketched and brainstormed low-fidelity wireframes.
4️⃣ Prototype – Designed high-fidelity screens using a modern, dark UI style.
5️⃣ Test – Evaluated usability and refined key user journeys for simplicity.
sections.solution:
The final design delivers a user-friendly and secure experience.
Key features include:

  • Quick account setup with guided onboarding
  • Biometric authentication for secure login
  • Simplified money transfers and bill payments
  • Expense tracking with categorized insights
  • Clean, modern dark UI for comfort and focus

‍
sections.result: The project resulted in a complete UX case study demonstrating the full process—from user research to final prototype. FlexiBank successfully meets the goal of creating a secure, accessible, and efficient banking experience, tailored for users in Nigeria who need reliable financial tools on the go.
